subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers require or run live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before treating this branch as the canonical fix, or explicitly waive that proof gap for this narrow header-only patch?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and well-covered by source tests, but the external provider behavior cannot be proven from this contributor's environment and several duplicate branches are competing for the same issue.

options.title: Require or provide live proof first
options.body: Choose one canonical branch only after redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof is added or run by a maintainer.

options.title: Waive the live proof gap
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the issue's live before-fix evidence plus this source/test proof and pick one duplicate branch to land.

options.title: Pause until a canonical branch is chosen
options.body: Leave the candidate PRs open but do not merge any until maintainers pick the branch and proof bar.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live proof first
recommendation.body: Choose one canonical branch only after redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof is added or run by a maintainer.

likelyOwner.reason: The endpoint auto-detection feature history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner for the proof and canonical-branch decision.
